verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Microsoft 365 Copilot integration in Teams ('Securely interact with Copilot using web data and work data') and Teams-native agent features (agent creation, slash commands, agent chat), indicating a built-in AI assistant users can invoke. However, evidence is largely developer/platform-oriented (building custom agents/bots) rather than end-user task delegation, and no community evidence corroborates real-world use of Copilot for task delegation.
